articles.title: Duke Energy reports fourth-quarter and full-year 2025 financial results

articles.summary: To help families in need with their electric bills this winter, Duke Energy Foundation has invested $187,500 into the Share the Light Fund, approaching $520,00 over the past year.
articles.title: Duke Energy approaches $520,000 in energy bill assistance in South Carolina over past year with $187,500 in new funding following prolonged cold

articles.summary: Duke Energy has been recognized by Fortune magazine as one of the World’s Most Admired Companies for 2026, marking the company’s ninth consecutive year on the list.
articles.title: Duke Energy again named by Fortune one of World’s Most Admired Companies™

articles.summary: Duke Energy Foundation is investing $500,000 in North Carolina community colleges to help strengthen the state’s energy workforce and prepare students for high-demand craft and technical careers.
articles.title: Duke Energy invests $500,000 in North Carolina community colleges to strengthen energy workforce pipeline

articles.summary: Duke Energy Foundation is investing $500,000 to support local environmental resilience projects across North Carolina that conserve natural resources, restore habitats and expand access to outdoor spaces
articles.title: Duke Energy Foundation commits $500,000 to support local environmental resilience programs across North Carolina

articles.summary: Duke Energy is advancing its commitment to customer safety by deploying artificial intelligence (AI) to detect scams targeting energy customers. This innovative technology scans websites, social media and paid advertisements for open-source social engineering threats, helping to protect customers from fraudulent schemes.
articles.title: Duke Energy leverages AI to protect customers and combat scams

articles.summary: Floridians will likely see higher power bills after last week’s cold snap, but Duke Energy is here to help its customers with bill-payment resources and important fraud prevention information.
articles.title: Duke Energy is here to help Florida customers after cold snap

articles.summary: To help families in need with their electric bills this winter, Duke Energy Foundation has invested $562,500 into the Share the Light Fund, approaching $4 million in funding over the past year.
articles.title: Duke Energy approaches $4 million in energy bill assistance in North Carolina over past year with $562,500 in new funding following prolonged cold

articles.summary: Duke Energy Ohio & Kentucky are advancing their commitments to customer safety by deploying artificial intelligence (AI) to detect scams targeting energy customers.
articles.title: Duke Energy Ohio & Kentucky leverage AI to protect customers and combat scams

articles.summary: Customers’ actions helped lessen strain on the electric grid and supported reliable service during one of the coldest mornings of the season.
articles.title: Duke Energy: Thank you, Carolinas customers, for conserving energy during extreme cold on Monday morning

articles.summary: Duke Energy Florida has launched an energy-saving pilot project in the Hunter’s Creek neighborhood of Orlando. As part of the initiative, battery energy storage systems (BESS) have been installed in more than 75 participating single-family homes to help manage energy use and support the electric grid during high-demand periods.
articles.title: Duke Energy Florida launches Residential Battery Storage Pilot in Orlando’s Hunter’s Creek neighborhood

articles.summary: Duke Energy is teaming up with several North Carolina properties for inclusion in its Site Readiness Program, which prepares high-potential industrial sites for economic development investments, making the sites more competitive for companies seeking to expand or relocate their operations.
articles.title: Duke Energy helps communities across North Carolina attract jobs and capital investment

articles.summary: Out of 2 million customers, more than 1.7 million Duke Energy Florida customers now benefit from self-healing technology. That’s 82% of our customers and more than double the number of customers who were served with the technology in 2020.
articles.title: Duke Energy Florida’s smart, self-healing technology investments help keep customers’ lights on

articles.summary: Duke Energy’s nuclear fleet set a new reliability record in 2025, providing communities across the Carolinas with around-the-clock power customers can count on.
articles.title: Duke Energy nuclear fleet sets new all-time reliability record, delivers value for customers
